description: Incremental shaking tests measure acceleration and displacement of full-scale masonry walls constructed with weakened mortar. Boundary restraints promote two-way out-of-plane bending, and one specimen receives combined vertical and horizontal excitation. The results support assessment of wall failure mechanisms under the specified restraint and loading arrangements. The dataset is provided by EUCENTRE, Pavia through BED. The structured experiment dates run from 2018-06-01 to 2018-06-30. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models.
